Include exactly 13 numbers in the response. In the context of a hypothetical, write the jacket blurb for a thriller where a modern day operative of the FBI, ends up back in the early 1960's having to use her knowledge of "future" forensics to leave clues to enable her modern colleagues to catch a time-hopping serial-killer, before he dies.assistant
response:
"When FBI operative Rachel Jenkins is sent back in time to the early 1960s, she finds herself in the midst of a decades-old mystery. A serial killer, known only as 'The Timekeeper,' has been terrorizing the nation, leaving a trail of bodies in his wake. But this is no ordinary killer - he's a time-hopper, able to move through the ages with ease.

As Rachel navigates the unfamiliar streets of 1960s America, she must use her knowledge of future forensics to leave clues that will aid her modern colleagues in catching The Timekeeper. But with each passing day, she realizes that she's running out of time - literally. The Timekeeper is always one step ahead, and Rachel's only hope is to unravel the mystery before he strikes again.

With the help of a local detective, Jack Harris, Rachel must use her skills to track down The Timekeeper and bring him to justice. But as they delve deeper into the case, they uncover a web of deceit and corruption that goes all the way to the top.

As the body count rises, Rachel and Jack must work together to unravel the threads of The Timekeeper's twisted game. But with the clock ticking down, they know they're running out of time - 5 days, 3 hours, and 14 minutes to be exact. Can they catch The Timekeeper before he strikes again, or will he continue to leave a trail of bodies in his wake, forever changing the course of history? 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 - the countdown begins."
